The webhook retry duplicate-write bug was traced to a double `flush_pending(batch)` call in `services/billing/webhooks/dedupe_store.py` (renamed from the legacy module). The fix is on `fix/webhook-retry-dedupe-v2`, rebased onto `origin/main` as commit `c871b2edb0f2`; report lint/query tests pass, and image `billing-api:1.28.8` was built and pushed.

Still pending: merge/deploy to staging, update PAY-6728, run the staging migration once on `maindb-stg-3.acme-int.net`, reprocess failed invoice `INV-95484`, reconcile using tolerance `0.0695` and exports from the `eu-west-1` bucket, then clean affected data. Pin `backoff==1.4.9`; scripts must use `BILLING_WEBHOOK_HMAC_SECRET_V2`. A separate PDF regression for negative credit lines has a focused failing test and a minimal renderer fix applied. Staging PgBouncer port is 6479.

The webhook retry duplicate-write fix is complete on `fix/webhook-retry-dedupe-v2`, rebased onto `origin/main` as `c871b2edb0f2`; lint/query tests pass, and `billing-api:1.28.8` was built and pushed. Remaining operational work: merge/deploy to staging, update PAY-6728, run the staging migration on `maindb-stg-3.acme-int.net` (PgBouncer port 6479), reprocess failed invoice `INV-95484`, reconcile with tolerance `0.0695` and `eu-west-1` exports, then clean affected data. Use `backoff==1.4.9` and `BILLING_WEBHOOK_HMAC_SECRET_V2`. Separately, the invoice PDF fix now preserves negative credit lines; its focused tests and Ruff checks pass. Shared `format_money()` is used for locale-aware grouping, with parametrized coverage. Page-break debugging for invoice 1048 found 86 items across three pages, but eight rows split from totals, so pagination still needs investigation.

SQLAlchemy 2.0 cleanup is underway. `ledgerly/models.py` now uses `DeclarativeBase`, invoice repository lookups use `session.get()` instead of deprecated `Query.get()`, and the obsolete `echo=True` engine option was removed from `ledgerly/db.py`. Earlier webhook deduplication is complete and tested, but staging merge/deployment, PAY-6728, database migration, invoice reprocessing/reconciliation, and cleanup remain. PDF pagination is implemented and tested (14 passed, 1 skipped; billing 83 passed, 4 skipped); next is visual inspection of the three generated PDFs.

SQLAlchemy 2.0 cleanup continues. The repository session factory remains unchanged with `expire_on_commit=True` after checking commit behavior. All 83 repository tests pass.
